why: The engine was published as github.com/wowlocal/randori (615251e, tag v0.1.0); its first CI run passed on Linux (swift:6.4.0-noble) and failed on GitHub's macOS runner (macos-15, Xcode 16.4, Swift 6.1): 'the compiler is unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time' at the SDL targets and at Package(...).
change: engine/Package.swift builds the SDL and Android dependency and flag lists step by step, collects the host products and targets in loops and names the core products and targets before Package(...). tools/crossplatform/engine_standalone.sh exports engine/ from the submodule's own repository when engine/ is a submodule (for E8b-2).

neutrality.method: swift package dump-package (Xcode 27, Swift 6.4) under eleven switch combinations, old against new manifest, in the same directory

swift61: Docker swift:6.1-noble (6.1.3) evaluates the new manifest in about 1 s (the old one timed out); the engine's sources still need a newer compiler (6.1 and 6.2 stop at an ambiguous withUnsafeBytes in RandoriRuntime/OriginalFramebufferPNG.swift:24), so Randori requires Swift 6.4, which its CI now installs on macOS
